findings.explanation: HOL4 introduces THE with new_recursive_definition, which uses new_specification on the single clause THE (SOME x) = x. Nothing saved fixes THE NONE. The Lean definition adds a clause for none, so Lean proves THE none = ARB by rfl. It also proves THE none = HD []. ARB is itself in the mapped vocabulary: HOL4 declares it as an undefined constant. The SOME clause is faithful.
findings.repair:
noncomputable opaque THE_NONE {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : α

noncomputable def THE {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : Option α → α
  | some x => x
  | none => THE_NONE
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.List

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.THE (none : Option α) = CmlTS.ARB := rfl

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.THE (none : Option α) = CmlTS.HD ([] : List α) := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ?f:num option -> num. (!x. f (SOME x) = x) /\ f NONE <> ARB

findings.explanation: HOL4 defines HD by the single clause HD (h::t) = h. Definition takes the PRIMREC route (Defn.sml:1182, Prim_rec.sml:281), which is new_specification on that clause with no ARB completion, so HD [] is left open. The Lean definition adds HD [] = ARB, provable by rfl. Lean then also proves HD [] = THE none and EL n [] = ARB (EL n l = ARB for every n ≥ length l). The cons clause is faithful, and EL itself matches HOL4 once HD is repaired.
findings.repair:
noncomputable opaque HD_NIL {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : α

noncomputable def HD {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | h :: _ => h
  | [] => HD_NIL
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.List

example {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : CmlTS.HD ([] : List α) = CmlTS.ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ?f:num list -> num. (!h t. f (h::t) = h) /\ f [] <> ARB
